question: Let \(a\) be the largest integer strictly smaller than \(\frac78b\) where \(b\) is also an integer. Consider the following inequalities: (1) \(\frac78b-a\le1\), (2) \(\frac78b-a\ge\frac18\), and find which of the following is correct.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
